question: How does semester promotion and performance abandonment work?
answer: Promotion from an Odd semester to an Even semester carries no restriction. You may abandon either end-semester performance or total semester performance at most twice during your degree within the same academic year, though doing so or passing in multiple attempts disqualifies you from Rank or Honours.
